It is given orally as the hydrochloride in the management of hyper- tension (p.1171). The initial dose is 5 to 10 mg once daily, in- creased, according to response, to a usual maintenance dose of 10 to 20 mg once daily. ◊ Reviews. 1. Malhotra HS, Plosker GL. Barnidipine. Drugs 2001; 61: 989–96. 2. Liau CS. Barnidipine: a new calcium channel blocker for hyper- tension treatment. Expert Rev Cardiovasc Ther 2005; 3: 207–13. Беметизид C15H16ClN3O4S2 = 401.9. CAS — 1824-52-8. Profile Bemetizide is a thiazide diuretic (see Hydrochlorothiazide, p.1307) that is used, often with triamterene, in the treatment of oedema and hypertension.
